headline: President Obama signed an order in 2011 updating the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This executive order makes changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the rules for how criminal cases are handled in the US military justice system. The manual covers trial procedures, rules of evidence, and punishments. The title alone does not say which specific rules were changed.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members charged with crimes under military law are tried under the rules in this manual, so changes to it can affect how their cases are handled.
People who run or take part in courts-martial must follow the updated rules.
